Cyber Crime Statistics in India

Cyber crime in India has seen an alarming rise in recent years. According to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB), reported cyber crimes have increased by over 700% since 2019.

Financial fraud represents the largest category, with phishing, KYC fraud, and UPI scams being the most common methods used by criminals to target Indian citizens.

The Indian government has responded by strengthening the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal and establishing dedicated cyber cells across the country, but public awareness remains the most effective defense.
